_doc: Scenario graph. Each scenario starts from its parent's savestate (null = cold boot) and runs `script` (see Harness.run_script). `expect.loaded` lists overlays that must be loaded afterwards. States live under build/<game>/emu/states/ (regenerable, never committed). The build dir has no save file, so boot goes intro -> title -> ov36 main menu (17 frames, NEW GAME only) -> ov53 new-game tutorial.

tutorial_menu.note: ov53: 'CONTROL INFO / ADVENTURE INFO / NO INFO NEEDED' touch menu, idle

tutorial_controls.note: ov53 after touching CONTROL INFO (bottom-screen y=40; ADVENTURE INFO y=96, NO INFO NEEDED y=151): text box + Touch panel
